تلتمسين (form VIII)
# تَلْتَمِسِينَ (taltamisīna) /tal.ta.mi.siː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِلْتَمَسَ (iltamasa)
# تُلْتَمَسِينَ (tultamasīna) /tul.ta.ma.siː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِلْتَمَسَ (iltamasa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
